bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for the final segment of the Glacial Lakes Trail.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; GLACIAL LAKES TRAIL.

$4,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources to design and construct the final trail segment for the Glacial Lakes Trail, established under Minnesota Statutes, section 85.015, subdivision 5, between the city of New London and Sibley State Park. This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
